title: Staffix component guide
description: What a skill configuring a component needs beyond its settings, written as <settings class>.guide.yaml beside the class and shipped in the component's schema as x-staffix.guide. Never what that schema already holds: defaults, required settings, JVM flags, artifacts, selection rules.

summary.description: What the component is, and when to pick it.

proving.description: How a test proves the component works.

failures.description: What the user sees when something is wrong, and what to do about it.

symptom.description: What the user sees: an error message, a test passing with the component broken, a lost sequence.

fix.description: The cause, and what to do about it.

behaviour.description: How the component behaves at runtime, for the user to know when it is handed over.
